abstract: Maintains emissions monitoring certifications and gas sensor response verification logs
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance lead (ENV). The Environmental compliance lead (ENV) oversees environmental monitoring systems, gas sensor performance verifications, and industrial operating permit records across candidate solvent recovery facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Operating permit administration（PERM）
information_points.content:
ENV-PERM-J3C：According to the Saxony regional emissions registry under the Federal Immission Control Act commercial permit, High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex has an operating permit remaining validity of 5 years before mandatory re-validation.
ENV-PERM-VNN：According to the Saxony regional emissions registry under the Federal Immission Control Act commercial permit, Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility has an operating permit remaining validity of 3 years before mandatory re-validation.

information_points.title: Maintains emissions monitoring certifications and gas sensor response verification logs（EHS）
information_points.content:
ENV-EHS-P0M：For High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex, the VOC continuous monitoring system is confirmed active on the scrubber and carbon bed exhaust stacks, and the vapor breakthrough detection time is 15 min according to the gas chromatograph calibration log for the adsorption bed warning circuit.
ENV-EHS-TQF：For Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant, the VOC continuous monitoring system is active on the scrubber and carbon bed exhaust stacks, while its adsorption bed warning circuit shows a vapor breakthrough detection time of 35 min based on the gas chromatograph calibration log.
ENV-EHS-GSL：For Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility, the stack monitoring instrumentation certificate confirms that the VOC continuous monitoring system is active across the scrubber and carbon bed exhaust stacks, and the gas chromatograph calibration log indicates a vapor breakthrough detection time of 10 min for the adsorption bed breakthrough warning circuit.
